task_defect.reason: Governing requirements R22 and R29 contain an arithmetic error that contradicts the source request. From the request: current total cost = USD 10,000 (INR 830,000), current assembly = USD 1,300 (INR 107,900, per R16), and current overhead = USD 200 (INR 16,600, per R17). Unchanged child-part costs are therefore 830,000 - 107,900 - 16,600 = INR 705,500 (USD 8,500 * 83), making the localized per-pack cost 705,500 + 20,000 + 590 = INR 726,090 and the unit cost reduction 103,910 / 830,000 = 12.52%. However, R22 erroneously specifies 683,000 + 20,000 + 590 = INR 703,590, and R29 specifies ~15.2% based on that erroneous subtraction.
